items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: He had Hal Galper on piano and Roy McCurdy on drums. And a guy sitting next to me, another trumpet player in the band whose last name was McCurdy, he said, “I wonder if I’m related to him.” Turned out they are cousins.

ctx.x: Nat raised me as a musician. He and Cannonball knew my father when they were all here at Florida A&M as students. And see ‘cause when I started playing the horn, see my parents always had music in the house growing up. And my dad said, “Oh you’re playing the cornet, well you’ve got to hear Nat Adderley, that’s my buddy from school you know, and Cannonball Adderley and them. And so, and they were all part of the same social circles, you know all the doctor this and professor this and this and that and the other.…
